decisionsTitle: The facelift, phase 2: a cover on every event and the event kind
decisionsSection: **The owner, 2026-10-11**, approving the redesign plan (§692, `docs/REDESIGN.md`): the facelift is the last item in the queue and must be planned carefully; phases 1 and 2 start with every default the plan names, so decision 9 is taken by its default. Phase 2 is data, editor and domain: a cover picture per event with its crop, carried by a series and picked in the editor like every picture in the house; the event's kind derived from its series; both exposed on the public read for phases 3 to 5. **No public page changes in this phase.** Amends §692 (decision 9 is `decided` by default), §168 (the special edition keeps its meaning beside the kind) and §49 (a series carries one more pair of columns by scope). The migration number is `0141`; the dispatcher renumbers it if a sibling takes it. **Decision — the cover.** - **Two columns, migration `0141`, expand only:** `events.cover_media_asset_id` (a stored picture of the gallery, `media_assets`) and `events.cover_crop` (the four fractions of §541, null for the whole picture), with a CHECK that a crop never exists without its picture. **No foreign key, on purpose:** `gallery.ts` imports `events.ts` (an album belongs to an event), so a reference back would make the two schema files import each other, and which one evaluated first would decide whether the enums exist yet. The guard is the one every picture held by address already has (the bib design's, §560): `media/references.ts` counts the column, so neither the orphan sweep nor a delete from the pictures page can take a picture a cover uses, and the pictures page lists it as used by the event; every read joins the store, so an id that names nothing is no cover rather than a broken one. - **«Copertă» in the editor** (`ui/boxes/CoverBox.tsx`), on the create page and the editor alike, among the cards that are not on the page (the page does not draw it yet): «Echipa»'s picture field (`TeamPhotoField`) under its own stem, `event.cover`, as the shop's size guide took it (§705) — the upload with its quality choice, «Din galerie» (§485), and the crop box, which starts at the picture's largest 16∶9, the card's own frame (§454; the field gained an optional `shape`). The card's closed line says «aleasă» or «lipsește». A role that may not change the event row reads one line instead; where no picture store is configured the card says so. - **The save.** The two hidden inputs are read only when the form carried them (the partners' discipline, §169): a form without the box never takes a cover off; an empty box clears both columns. `fields.ts` refuses an id that is not a UUID and a crop that is not one; the service refuses an id that is no stored picture or a film's poster (`yt-`, §485), asked only when the picture changes. Every refusal names «Copertă › Fotografia de copertă». Each change writes `event.cover_changed` (from and to by id, never a file name, and whether the new one is cropped), on a create that carries one and on every date a save changed. - **A series.** The two columns are in `SERIES_COLUMNS`, like the route (§49, §130): «this and the following» or «all» carry a new cover, and the picture and its crop always travel together, so no date is left with a crop of another picture, or with a crop and no picture. A repeat copies the cover to every date it makes; a duplicate starts with last year's. - **The events list** marks a line whose next date, still to come, has no cover: «Fără copertă», an outlined warning chip beside «Locație neanunțată». The plan's gate for this phase is that every weekly run and the race carry one; the uploading is the club's. **Decision — the kind.** `events/domain/event-kind.ts#eventKind`: **weekly** for a date of a standing series whose rule repeats every week (§122) — the source's own rule, reached from every date it made through `repeat_of` — and **special** for everything else: a race, a hike, a coffee, a one-off, a series every two weeks or every month, and a series stopped with «Oprește recurența», whose source is a one-off again (§275). The plan's decision 9, taken as written. **Derived, never typed:** no column, no flag, no select. The type gives the photo tag its glyph and nothing else. - **«Ediție specială» keeps its meaning (§168).** One date of a weekly run marked special is still a weekly date for the kind and wears the chip beside it. - **The photo tag** (the plan's «tag pill» on a card's photo) is data here: `coverTag` gives the kind, its catalogue key (`Event.kind.weekly` «Săptămânal» / "Weekly", `Event.kind.special` «Eveniment special» / "Special event") and a name of the public glyph registry — the public repeat arrows (`repeat`, §486) for a weekly run, the type's own glyph for a special one — so phase 5 draws it from a Server Component without an element prop (§370). **Decision — through the public cache.** Every public read (`PUBLIC_COLUMNS`, and so the listing, the calendar, the feed, the page and the members' reads) carries `cover` — one JSON value with the stored picture's key prefix, its size and the crop, from a scalar subquery on the picture's primary key, null for none or a poster — and `seriesCadence`, the source's cadence, from a scalar subquery on the source's primary key. Both travel through the public cache with the row; drawing a cover asks the database nothing. `events/domain/cover.ts#readPublicCover` reads the value, never throwing; `events/cover.ts#coverSources` builds what an `` needs: the master, the ladder's `srcset` for a picture stored with one and none for an older one (§414, §601), `sizes` for the column it is drawn in with the crop's magnification, the thumbnail, the size and the crop. The editor's preview carries no cover yet (its picture's facts are a read of the store the preview mapping does not make) and the kind's cadence only on a series' source. **What phases 3 to 5 draw from this.** Phase 3, the home page: «Următoarea alergare» and the weekly and special sections split by `eventKind`, each card with its cover on top and the photo tag. Phase 4, the calendar: the kind as a filter dimension and its colours with a word beside them, the next-event panel with its cover. Phase 5, the listing and the event page: the card's photo on top (`coverSources`, plain `img`, only the hero eager), the tag pill (`coverTag`) in the kind's tokens from phase 1, the editor's preview given its cover. All of it under «Aspectul nou»; with the setting off, nothing reads the two new values. **Refused.** A kind typed by hand or stored beside the series (a second answer to one question, wrong the first time a series is stopped). Stock or generated pictures (decision 6: real photographs of the club only; the picker offers only what the club stored). A picture table of its own for covers (the column is what a series edit, a repeat and a duplicate already carry). A foreign key through the schema import cycle. An alt-text box per language (the card's title sits beside the picture; `event_translations.cover_alt_text`, unused since §36, stays unread). A new public glyph for the list's chip (§694's owed note: every name added to the public table ships to every public chip island). **Not run.** No Playwright and no production build ran on this branch, by the brief: no public page changed, the editor gained one card, and the listing specs are untouched; `tests/e2e/client-words.spec.ts` walks the editor in CI.
changelogLine: - **A cover photo for every event** — the event editor's new «Copertă» card picks a club photo from the gallery or an upload, with its crop; a series carries it, and the events list marks the upcoming events still without one. Each event's kind (a weekly run or a special event) is now worked out from its series. Nothing changes on the public pages yet: the new look draws both in its next phases. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the create page or the editor of an event, when it renders, then among the cards that are not on the page it holds «Copertă» (`#box-cover`): the house's picture field — an upload with its quality choice, «Din galerie» and the crop box starting at the picture's largest 16∶9 — posting `event.coverAssetId` and `event.coverCrop`. A save that carried the field stores the picture and its crop, an empty field clears both, and a form without it changes neither; an id that is no stored picture, a film's poster or a crop that is not one is refused naming «Copertă»; every change is audited as `event.cover_changed` with the picture's id before and after. A series edit carries the picture and its crop together to the dates it reaches, a repeat copies them to every date it makes and a duplicate keeps them (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
Given the backoffice events list, when a line's next date is still to come and has no cover, then the line wears «Fără copertă» / "No cover" (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a published event, when any public read returns it, then the row carries its cover — the stored picture's key prefix, its size and its crop, or null — and the cadence of the standing series it belongs to; the event's kind is «weekly» exactly when that cadence is weekly and «special» otherwise (a one-off, a race, a series every two weeks or monthly, a stopped series), never read from a value the club types (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a stored picture chosen as an event's cover, when the orphan sweep runs or the pictures page's delete is pressed, then the picture is kept and the delete is refused, and the pictures page lists it as used by that event (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
